name: Taktile
long_description:
Taktile is the Agentic Decision Platform for banking and insurance. Our platform combines data, rules, AI agents, and human expertise to enable banks and insurers to constantly improve business and consumer underwriting, customer onboarding, and claims management. Over 200 banks and insurers use Taktile to onboard more qualified customers, lend to the right businesses, and settle claims faster. Our team of forward-deployed engineers enables risk, operations, and technical teams to implement, test, and refine every decision while staying in control.

Taktile is backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Index Ventures, Tiger Global, Balderton Capital, and Y Combinator.
one_liner: Taktile is the Agentic Decision Platform for banking and insurance.
